structuredContent.summary: Analysis of Cromite filter identity mapping. The configuration defines canonical identities hosted at uazo.github.io. The inventory provides evidence for mapping these to raw.githubusercontent.com/uazo/cromite/pages/. Most identities in GetKnownSubscriptions() have corresponding entries in the inventory. 'easyprivacy.txt' is explicitly unmapped. The experimental filter list (raw.githubusercontent.com/uazo/cromite/master/...) is correctly identified as having no pages-list fallback. I propose a static helper to perform this bounded mapping.
architecture_observations: Mapping is strictly filename-based; no arbitrary prefixing allowed.
Experimental identity (master branch) must remain distinct from pages-list.
Existing 'MaybeSplitCombinedAdblockList' is host-specific to ABP domains and should not be used for Cromite mapping.

proposed_changes.change: Add declaration for 'GURL GetCromiteFallbackUrl(const GURL& canonical_url);'.
Implement 'GetCromiteFallbackUrl' using strict filename extraction and host replacement.

risks: Incorrect path parsing could lead to mapping non-filter files.
Strict host checking is required to prevent accidental mapping of experimental/master URLs.
tests: Test invalid host: https://example.com/filters/test.txt -> empty GURL
